description: Preregistered independent-family micro-local benchmark. A relation-genesis family and a separately source-born processual-hermeneutic family compete inside one controlled document. The benchmark tests local selection, cross-family composition, negative-control abstention and preservation of polyphonic boundaries.

candidates.label: Geviert-born co-constitutive gathering profile
candidates.rationale: Relation-family control: must win only on reciprocal gathering/distance windows and may compose with an independent family only when the same local window supports both.

candidates.label: Source-born temporal enactment profile
candidates.rationale: Independent processual-family profile: expectation and enactment should be locally discriminating without being re-described as relation-genesis.

candidates.label: Source-born practice/material mediation profile
candidates.rationale: Independent processual-family profile for repeated embodied/material mediation.

candidates.label: Source-born absence/trace disclosure profile
candidates.rationale: Independent processual-family profile that keeps trace/disclosure below causal or existence proof.

expected_windows.heading: W1 — Temporal enactment
expected_windows.rationale: Temporal enactment should beat the narrower practice profile because it covers both the temporal and practice hints in this window.

expected_windows.heading: W2 — Practice and material mediation
expected_windows.rationale: Material/repetitive enactment should select the practice-mediation profile without a temporal expectation requirement.

expected_windows.heading: W3 — Absence and trace
expected_windows.rationale: Absence plus trace/disclosure should select its own profile rather than relation-genesis.

expected_windows.heading: W4 — Geviert-style relation control
expected_windows.rationale: The older relation-genesis family must remain available and locally superior on reciprocal gathering with preserved distance.

expected_windows.heading: W5 — Cross-family composition
expected_windows.rationale: The window deliberately carries non-redundant relation and processual signals; the system should compose families locally without creating a global meta-ontology.

expected_windows.heading: W6 — Descriptive negative control
expected_windows.rationale: A bare descriptive window should defeat both families and prevent least-bad routing.
